prerequisites.scalar_parent_case: isotropic coupling_continuation entry with lambda_x=0.5, lambda_y=0.5, lambda_xy=0.0

included: known-map recovery of central and off-axis scalar onsite plants
D4 covariance of the off-axis onsite orbit
blind-map non-identifiability under translation and point-group symmetry
separation of reconstruction agreement from numerical criteria
excluded: directional or nonlocal defect model classes
area, shape, orientation, or twist-mesh convergence

represented_space.coordinate_reduction: apply integer maps first, then reduce each component modulo 8
represented_space.energy_reference: identified scalar-parent zero before the authored attack

d4_action.vector_convention: column vectors; operation names act on canonical coordinates from the left
d4_action.twist_convention: the same orthogonal integer matrix maps phi to M*phi, followed by componentwise reduction to [0,1)
d4_action.orbit_uniqueness_requirement: all eight off_axis_target values must be distinct
group_checks: every matrix is integral and orthogonal
the ordered set is closed under multiplication
every permutation unitary is exactly unitary
matrix multiplication agrees with permutation composition
the listed orbit equals the generated orbit exactly

known_map_attack.composition_order: apply reflection_antidiagonal, then translation, with source-site phase multiplying the mapped ket
known_map_attack.site_phase_formula_radians: theta(x,y)=0.137*x-0.191*y on the canonical source site
known_map_attack.candidate_twist_formula: M*phi modulo one; translation and site phases do not change the declared twist
known_map_attack.inverse_order: remove energy shift, source-site phases, translation, then point-group operation before subtraction

nominal_case_inventory.ordering: central cases in base-twist order, followed by base twist outer and ordered D4 operation inner for the off-axis orbit

covariance_controls.twist_handling_rule: the full-Hamiltonian metric, not the twist-independent onsite defect alone, owns the boundary-twist covariance claim

input_visibility: reference and candidate geometry and boundary-twist metadata
blind_alignment_controls.search_order: twist-compatible D4 operations in accepted order, then translations with x outer and y inner
blind_alignment_controls.phase_inference: synchronize edge-phase ratios on the nonzero pristine hopping graph with theta(0,0)=0
blind_alignment_controls.objective: Frobenius mismatch over off-diagonal site blocks only
blind_alignment_controls.energy_shift_diagnostic: median of the real aligned diagonal differences; no trace mean is permitted because the single onsite plant biases it
blind_alignment_controls.result_rule: retain the complete ordered ambiguity set and common shift diagnostic, but return no selected map and no extracted operator
blind_alignment_controls.interpretation: translation and, at Gamma, D4 are genuine host symmetries; the blind route does not identify an absolute defect site without an external anchor

omitted_energy_reference_correction.interpretation: negative diagnostic, not an impurity estimate

fixed_generic_twist_under_quarter_turn.correct_comparator: full Hamiltonian at the quarter-turn-transformed twist
fixed_generic_twist_under_quarter_turn.adverse_comparator: full Hamiltonian incorrectly kept at the original generic twist
fixed_generic_twist_under_quarter_turn.failure_rule: if the adverse mismatch does not exceed the floor, Stage B fails as nondiscriminating; the twist or threshold is not changed

plant_leakage.required_check: the blind-alignment serialized input and callable interface contain no planted site, strength, known map, or oracle error
plant_leakage.failure_rule: implementation or verifier rejects the run before any nominal result is interpreted

known_map_required: maximum-entry and Frobenius recovery defects <= algebraic_absolute
recovered scalar amplitude absolute defect <= algebraic_absolute
covariance_required: every correctly transformed operator and full-Hamiltonian covariance defect <= symmetry_covariance_absolute
every symmetry-related eigenvalue maximum defect <= symmetry_covariance_absolute
blind_required: exact ambiguity inventories and counts reproduced
selected map and extracted operator are null
no planted or known-map field crosses the inference boundary
criteria.criterion_disposition: retain pass or fail and exact failed criteria separately from independent reconstruction agreement

independent_routes: reconstruct the scalar parent from retained hopping coefficients
construct D4 matrices and site permutations from integer formulas rather than retained runner permutations
reconstruct attacked operators from compact plants and the closed map formula
enumerate the exact nominal and ambiguity inventories
recompute phase synchronization and median shift diagnostics
reproduce known-map extraction, covariance, adverse controls, criteria, and all matrix digests
mutation_checks_required_before_executio: unchanged generic twist under quarter turn
plant field injected into blind input
blind tie broken to one map
criterion failure relabeled as verifier failure
